chapter.heading: A Prayer for Divine Scrutiny and RedemptionA Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Vindicate me,
O Lord,For I have walked in my integrity.I have also trusted in the Lord;I shall not slip.

Examine me,
O Lord, and prove me;Try my mind and my heart.

For Your
lovingkindness is before my eyes,And I have walked in Your truth.

I have
not sat with idolatrous mortals,Nor will I go in with hypocrites.

I have
hated the assembly of evildoers,And will not sit with the wicked.

I will
wash my hands in innocence;So I will go about Your altar, O Lord,

That I
may proclaim with the voice of thanksgiving,And tell of all Your wondrous works.

Lord, I
have loved the habitation of Your house,And the place where Your glory dwells.

Do not
gather my soul with sinners,Nor my life with bloodthirsty men,

In whose
hands is a sinister scheme,And whose right hand is full of bribes.

But as
for me, I will walk in my integrity;Redeem me and be merciful to me.

My foot
stands in an even place;In the congregations I will bless the Lord.
